body:
Full-codebase review, web finding. Verified by reading.

Almost every localStorage access is unguarded, including `getDeviceId()` in `useSync`, which runs during render. In a browser with site data blocked (or private-mode Safari) the accessor throws and the app white-screens with no message. The i18n module already wraps its access in try/catch with a comment naming this exact hazard; `api/client.ts` and `api/protocol.ts` guard with `typeof !== "undefined"`, which does not survive a throwing accessor.

Fix direction: one `safeStorage` helper used everywhere, as i18n already does.
title: Web: unguarded storage access white-screens a browser with site data blocked
